idea.title: Your ad budget isn't the problem. Your reply speed is.
idea.angle: Paying for ads that bring leads nobody answers fast enough
idea.hook: It's not your ads. It's your replies.

slides.heading: It's not your ads. It's your **replies.**
slides.body: You're paying for leads nobody answers fast enough.

slides.heading: You paid for that DM
slides.body: Every enquiry from your Instagram ad cost you cedis or naira. Leave it for hours and that money is gone.

slides.heading: Your real **cost**
slides.body: Ad spend ÷ enquiries = cost per lead. Now count how many got a reply within an hour.

slides.heading: Check last week
slides.body: Scroll back through your DMs. How long did each enquiry wait for your first reply?

slides.heading: Find the gaps
slides.body: Evenings, weekends, viewing days. That's when ad leads sit unanswered.

slides.heading: Fix speed, then spend
slides.body: A bigger budget with slow replies just means more unanswered DMs.

slides.heading: Stop paying for **silence.**
slides.body: Follow @kortexa and DM 'SYSTEM' for a free trial

caption:
It's not your ads. It's your replies.

Every DM from your ad cost you money.
If it waits hours for a reply, the buyer has already moved on.
Work out your cost per lead: ad spend divided by enquiries.
Then check how many of those enquiries got a reply within the hour.
Fix reply speed before you raise the budget.

When do most of your ad leads arrive: daytime, evenings or weekends? 👇
